event.desc.fake_merchant:
[color=#E8C840]The Merchant???[/color] is a disguised vendor selling counterfeit relics for [color=#E8C840]50 Gold[/color] each. Six of nine possible fake items are available: knock-off versions of real relics.

[color=#7A8FA8]Act 2+, single-player only. Requires 100+ Gold to enter.[/color]
event.desc.relic_trader:
Trade one of [color=#E8C840]three random tradable relics[/color] from your inventory for a [color=#E8C840]random new relic[/color] of the trader's choosing. You pick which of your relics to offer; the replacement is pulled blind from the relic pool.

[color=#7A8FA8]Act 2+. Requires 5+ tradable relics.[/color]
event.desc.ranwid:
Ranwid trades a new relic for one of three offerings:
  - Give a [color=#E8C840]random potion[/color] - gain [color=#E8C840]1 relic[/color].
  - Pay [color=#E8C840]100 Gold[/color] - gain [color=#E8C840]1 relic[/color].
  - Give a [color=#E8C840]random tradable relic[/color] - gain [color=#E8C840]2 relics[/color].

The potion and relic given up are chosen at random from your inventory. Potions cannot be discarded until you leave the event.

[color=#7A8FA8]Act 2+. Requires 100+ Gold, 1+ potion, and 1+ tradable relic.[/color]
